basic_info.description: 120 Brewster Street is a stunning, newly completed modern home in Bernal Heights, one of San Francisco's premier neighborhoods. Designed by Zach Devito and finished by Vasos Peritos, this 4-level single-family home boasts a dramatic center staircase and a roof terrace with sweeping views of San Francisco and the Bay. The main level offers an open-concept great room, seamless indoor-outdoor flow to a spacious terrace, and a Chef's kitchen featuring Dacor and Bertazzoni appliances, custom cabinetry, a dramatic porcelain waterfall island, a wet bar, and a powder room. The entry level includes a 2-car garage and a formal foyer leading to the second floor, with two ensuite bedrooms and a laundry room. The fourth floor is home to the luxurious primary suite with Bay views, custom paneling, and a spa-like bathroom with a soaking tub, large shower, and floating double vanity. This level also includes an office/media room and guest bath. Located near a community garden, area parks,Cortland Avenue shop and major routes via I-280 and Hwy 101, this home is perfect for modern city living.
